title: MobChunkChallenge
description: Fight a random mob in every chunk before you can continue your adventure.
body:
# MobChunkChallenge

Turn every Minecraft world into a challenge!

Whenever a player enters a new chunk, a random hostile mob spawns. The chunk becomes locked and players cannot leave it until the mob has been defeated.

A visible particle border marks the chunk boundaries so you always know where the challenge area ends.

## Features

- Random mob spawns in every new chunk
- Chunk is locked until the mob is killed
- Visible chunk border using particles
- Multiplayer support
- Works in survival worlds
- Lightweight and simple gameplay mechanic
- Built for Paper 1.21.1
- Java 21

## How it Works

1. Enter a chunk.
2. A random mob appears.
3. The chunk becomes locked.
4. Kill the mob.
5. The chunk unlocks.
6. Continue to the next chunk and repeat.

## Supported Mobs

- Zombie
- Skeleton
- Creeper
- Spider
- Enderman
- Husk
- Stray
- Witch
- Pillager
- Vindicator

## Requirements

- Paper 1.21.1+
- Java 21
